Click here to rename the Track.
Click the speaker icon to the right of a track to mute/unmute the individual tracks, or click the mic to the left to mute/unmute all other tracks.
Right click the panels here to change which pattern each track plays.
Patterns are sequences of notes that are played by the track's selected instrument. Right click patterns here to rename them.
Moving this slider left or right alters the volume of this specific track. This volume is used for all patterns within the track.
Moving the slider left or right pans the audio between the respective speakers. If moved all the way to one side, all the track's audio will be played exclusively on that side's speaker.
Toggle the metronome; a series of timed beats designed to aid in measuring tempo.
